sections.label: Mind
Head
sections.text:
Feels full, stuffed up, pain across forehead
and above eyes. Great pressure at root of nose. Be-
wildered. l^ss of consciousness.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Painful, as of sand, smarting ; diflicult to
focus for close work.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Stuffed; tightness at bridge of nose, ’.acute
nasal catarrh.

sections.label: Face
sections.text: Bloated in morning. Puffy under eyes.

sections.label: Stomach
Abdomen
sections.text:
Intestinal flatulence. In morning rum-
bling in boweks, with desire tor stool.

sections.label: Rectum
sections.text:
Constipation, stools bard, small lumps.
Difficult, soft stools, with much .straining. Much flatus.
Bearing-down pain in rectum.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Difficulty of retaining ; dribbling when
walking. Frequent urination at night.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Bearing-down sensation. Vulva inflamed,
with furious itching. Increased sexual desire, with
ovarian and uterine pains and leucorrhcea.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Posterior nares raw ; discharge thick,
yellow mucus. Sneezing. Trachea sore; lumps feel
constricted.

sections.label: Back
sections.text:
Feels hot from sacrum to scapulae. Back-
ache, extending down legs. Pain over kidneys. Heat
deep in spine.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Muscular lameness, trembling. Pain
in knees. Limbs feel stiff.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Erythema, with vesication and intense itch-
ing, stinging, and burning. Blisters, little lumps. Skin
rough and cracked ; feds like leather. Dermatitis,
especially around knees. Inflammation resembling
poison oak. Inguinal glands and behind knee swollen.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, application of cold water, in
afternoon and evening. Better, application of hot water,
in morning, moving affected part.
